listing.name: Mario Kart 64 / SpaghettiKart [Android Port] (izzy2lost)
listing.summary: Explore Mario Kart 64 / SpaghettiKart [Android Port] (izzy2lost) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Install this fork’s Android APK, open it, and choose your own Mario Kart 64 US .z64 ROM. The upstream guide identifies SHA-1 579c48e211ae952530ffc8738709f078d5dd215e. This app verifies the ROM and creates mk64.o2r on the device; no PC Spaghettify/Torch step is required.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: The Android guide puts game data under Android/data/com.izzy.kart/files. Mods go in its mods folder as supported .o2r, .zip or plain folders and load next launch; .otr is not supported. Preserve your app data, saves, generated O2R and mods before updating or removing the app. Android/upstream owns replacement and storage; Portcove backup and runtime rollback do not cover it.
